metadata.title: Classic Country Greatest Hits Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a male artist occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, paired with a clean white background on the right. The composition features a horizontal header bar at the top and vertically stacked text on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer creates immediate engagement.
Horizontal header bar anchors the top edge and provides structural balance.
Warm skin tones and orange clothing contrast against the stark white negative space.
Text placement on the right balances the heavy visual weight of the portrait on the left.
coreInvariants: Horizontal banner at the top with decorative end-caps.
High-contrast white background for the text area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned off-center to the left, filling approximately 65% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary focal point, followed by the top header bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move up to the header, then down to the artist's name on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the right side provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and oranges in the portrait and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white background on the right side.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the artist's name and decorative flourishes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and the white background; moderate saturation in the warm tones.

letterConstructionRules: Header uses a bold, slightly rounded sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
Artist name uses a highly condensed, high-contrast serif with thin hairlines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, modern sans-serif header and a delicate, vintage condensed serif for the name.
graphicDevices: Horizontal grey banner with black border lines.
Symmetrical decorative flourishes (scrollwork) at the ends of the banner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and clarity of the header text.
Captures the extreme condensed nature and high contrast of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution close-up portrait of a man with a warm complexion and dark hair, wearing a solid orange collared shirt. The portrait should be positioned on the left, fading into a solid white background on the right side. The lighting should be soft and warm.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal grey banner across the top with thin black borders and red scrollwork icons at each end. Inside the banner, center bold sans-serif text in dark grey. On the right white space, stack the artist's name in a large, condensed red serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait off-center to the left?
Is the artist's name in a condensed red serif?
Does the header banner have decorative flourishes?
Is the background on the right pure white?

adjustableVariables: Color of the artist's name text
Specific decorative motifs in the banner
Width of the white negative space
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the hits count
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the banner is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the red color is consistent between the text and flourishes.
Confirm the portrait crop is tight and impactful.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on left (60%) + White space on right (40%) + Top horizontal banner with sans-serif + Right-aligned condensed serif name.
